Explanation:  
The question asks how long the predecessor of Queen Victoria (William IV) reigned. The ground truth answer is "6 years, 11 months, 25 days." The predicted answer states "6 years and 359 days (almost seven years)." Since 359 days is 11 months and 25 days, adding this to 6 years gives exactly "6 years, 11 months, 25 days." Therefore, the vital facts and meaning of the ground truth answer are present in the predicted answer, only expressed differently.

Decision: TRUE
